usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It builds with `wj run --compiled` and prints the right output for Example 1 (`the 3`, `and 1`). I didn't run Example 2 or any other input, so tie-breaking by word and the "fewer than K distinct words" case are untested.

It reads K from the first line and splits the rest into runs of ASCII letters and digits. It lower-cases each word and counts it in a `HashMap`
